deal.text: The easiest game ever! Just pick a pile and guess if the next card dealt will be *higher* or *lower* than the card shown.
Tap the *higher* button to guess that the next card will be higher than this 3.
You guessed correctly. *Aces are high* and *2s are low*.
Pick another pile and make a *new guess*.
Cards are drawn from *this deck*. The number on the deck is how many cards remain.
If you make a wrong guess, the *pile is killed*. Your goal is to get through the *entire deck* before all your piles are killed.
This graph tells you how many cards of each rank *remain*. You can *hold* on a rank for more information.
You can make a *Same* guess too! A correct Same guess charges this *Same Shield*, protecting a pile from the next wrong guess.

You can also *swipe* on piles instead of tapping.
Swipe *up* to guess higher
Swipe *down* to guess lower
Swipe *to the side* to guess same

mapHints: Calling Same on a Joker always lands. It banks the Same shield AND fires your Same-Power.
A correct Same banks a shield that saves a pile from death. It never stacks, so spend it.
Ties kill on Higher or Lower. Call Same, or carry a Same-Safe.
Anchor a tiny pile and it stops dragging your payout down.
Rerolls climb in price within a shop visit. Next store, fresh price.
Bosses always deal your whole deck. Keep it lean.
Hold the histogram and drag. It counts how many cards are higher, lower, or same.
Fan mode spreads a pile so you can see every card in it.
Hold anything (a card, a node, a shop item) and it tells you what it does.
Cards can only carry up to four stickers.
